svg.title: C# Access Modifiers Explained
svg.desc: Each access modifier shown with its scope: where it can be accessed from — same class, same assembly, derived class, or anywhere.

g.text: Defaults when you omit a modifier
Top-level class → internal · Class members → private · Interface members → public
